name: Classic Clear Glass Tequila Shot Glasses (Set of 12)
description: Get ready to host the ultimate party or game night! Up for grabs is a matching set of 12 classic, heavy-base clear shot glasses. Crafted from thick, high-quality durable glass, these 1.5 oz bar essentials feature a flared top rim and a heavily weighted solid bottom to prevent messy tips and spills. Perfect for tequila, whiskey, vodka, espresso shots, or creative mini dessert appetizers. Exceptionally clean, completely scratch-free, and dishwasher safe. A total staple for any home bar, college apartment, or hosting setup!
contact_note: Sold as a complete set of 12 glasses. Thoroughly washed, sanitized, and carefully packed into a secure box for easy transport. Ready for porch pickup!
meta_description: Pre-owned set of 12 clear heavy-base glass shot glasses in good condition. 1.5 oz capacity, flared rim, dishwasher safe barware essentials.
name_zh: 经典厚底无铅玻璃一口杯/烈酒杯 (12件套)
description_zh: 轰趴、朋友聚会或调酒桌必备！转让一套完整配套的12件装经典玻璃 Shot 杯（烈酒杯/一口杯）。容量约为 1.5 盎司，采用加厚耐用玻璃材质，标志性的微喇上口设计搭配扎实沉稳的加厚实心底座，有效防止倾倒和泼洒。无论是拿来喝龙舌兰、伏特加、威士忌，还是日常盛放意式浓缩咖啡（Espresso Shot）都极其好用。全套无任何划痕、无裂纹，已彻底清洗消毒。
